data.long_meaning: Ardeth is derived from the Old English word 'ard' meaning 'brave, strong' and 'deth' meaning 'death'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ardeth usually hope their child will grow to embody valiant, courageous one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
